title: Admissions Enquiries — 2026–2027 Academic Year
description: IFAK admits students into Ordinary Level and Advanced Level. Families interested in admission are invited to contact the school administration for guidance on the entry process.
content:
IFAK — Institut de Formation Apostolique de Kimihurura — admits learners into Ordinary Level and Advanced Level (A-Level).

At Advanced Level, IFAK offers five combinations: PCM (Physics–Chemistry–Mathematics), MCB (Mathematics–Chemistry–Biology), MCE (Mathematics–Computer Science–Economics), MEG (Mathematics–Economics–Geography) and MPC (Mathematics–Physics–Computer Science).

Parents and guardians seeking admission for the 2026–2027 academic year, or information on fees, boarding and day status, should contact the school administration directly:

• Phone: +250 787 949 474 · +250 788 519 195 · +250 782 379 300
• Email: info@ifakdonbosco.ac.rw
• Address: IFAK Don Bosco Kimihurura, KN 14 Ave 41, Kimihurura — Gasabo, Kigali

Note: boarding for girls is being developed as part of the school's future projects (see notice on the girls' dormitory). Admission requirements and timelines are set by the school administration and the national examination/registration calendar; please confirm current details with the school office.

title: Weekly Tests for Senior Three and Senior Six — National Examination Preparation
description: Senior Three and Senior Six students sit structured weekly tests modelled on the national examinations to build familiarity with format, timing and coverage.
content:
As part of its preparation system for the national examinations, IFAK organises weekly tests for Senior Three and Senior Six students.

• Senior Three: tests every Monday and Friday
• Senior Six: tests every Monday

The tests are set in the same spirit as the national examinations, covering the topics taught across the level (from Senior One for Senior Three). Each test is a three-hour paper, mirroring the national exam format.

The marks are recorded on the school report. This weekly practice has contributed to positive results and is intended to help students go into the national examinations with confidence.

Parents are encouraged to support students with regular revision, rest and a healthy routine at home.

title: Future Development Plans Include a Girls' Dormitory
description: During the 62nd anniversary celebration, the Director of IFAK confirmed that a girls' dormitory — along with a football pitch and a gymnasium — is included in future development projects.
content:
At the IFAK at 62 celebration on 7 February 2026, students, alumni and parents raised the long-standing call for a girls' dormitory so that girls can fully participate in boarding life.

The Director of IFAK, Rev. Fr. Ntirenganya Jean Bosco, responded: “We hear the strong desire to host both boys and girls in boarding. Plans for a girls' dormitory are included in our future development projects, along with a football pitch and a gymnasium. Our goal is to provide a complete environment for education and growth.”

The school community and its friends continue to support the realisation of these projects. Updates on fundraising and construction timelines will be published here as they are confirmed.

title: Construction of New Classrooms Ongoing at IFAK Don Bosco Kimihurura
description: Construction works for new classrooms are in progress on campus. Families and visitors should observe on-site safety notices during the works period.
content:
The school has confirmed that construction of new classrooms is ongoing at IFAK Don Bosco Kimihurura. The project responds to growing enrolment and the school's commitment to a complete environment for learning.

During the works:

• Access to the construction zone is restricted
• Visitors should report to the school office before entering campus
• Parents are kindly asked to respect safety signage when dropping or picking up students

Progress updates will be shared on this page and on the school's social media channels.

title: Congratulations: IFAK Team First Runner-Up — Money Makeover Challenge Cohort 3
description: Team IFAK (Balinda Cyemezo Bruce, Ineza Eluine, Kamanzi Marvel Frank) placed first runner-up in the Bank of Kigali / iDebate Rwanda Money Makeover Challenge Cohort 3.
content:
Institut de Formation Apostolique de Kimihurura secured the First Runner-Up position in the Money Makeover Challenge Cohort 3, organised by the Bank of Kigali in partnership with iDebate Rwanda.

The IFAK team — Balinda Cyemezo Bruce, Ineza Eluine and Kamanzi Marvel Frank — presented a financial project that impressed the panel of judges, earning a prize of 450,000 Rwandan Francs deposited into their individual Bank of Kigali accounts.

We congratulate Team IFAK and thank the teachers and mentors who supported them. Read the full story in the News section.
